question: The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs has launched an upgraded version of the National Youth Parliament Scheme (NYPS) web portal, NYPS 2.0, to expand the Youth Parliament Programme. With this initiative, citizens across the country can participate on the portal through which of the following modes?

options.text: Only Institution Participation and Group Participation
Only Individual Participation through online registration
Institution Participation and Individual Participation only
Institution Participation; Group Participation; Individual Participation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Institution Participation; Group Participation; Individual Participation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs unveiled NYPS 2.0, the upgraded web portal of the National Youth Parliament Scheme, to broaden youth participation across the country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **NYPS 2.0 allows participation through Institution, Group and Individual modes.**
 
• The upgraded portal removes earlier restrictions that limited participation to recognized educational institutions.
 
• It aims to ensure wider inclusion of students and citizens from remote and rural areas.
 
• The scheme promotes awareness and engagement with parliamentary practices among youth and citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• National Youth Parliament Scheme__

 __
 
• An initiative of the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs to promote democratic values among youth.
 
• Encourages understanding of parliamentary procedures and legislative functioning.
 
• Provides a structured platform for debate, discussion and policy awareness.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs__
 
 
• Responsible for coordinating matters related to Parliament.
 
• Acts as a link between the Government and the Parliament.
 
• Plays a key role in strengthening parliamentary democracy in India.
